content:
katie: Quick sync — post-launch plan for the community workshop + refapp. Goal: drive tutorial signups, show benchmark wins, capture inbound dev leads. Thoughts?

sam: Love it. We should lead with the benchmark headline (50% cost reduction vs baseline) + a short gif of the refapp in action :rocket:

alexa: Drafted headline and TL;DR in the doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/REFAPP-DRAFT — short bullets: what, why it matters, try locally, join webinar. Added a proposed tweet thread.

mike: Webinar logistics: propose Wed 2pm PT. Live demo + 20min Q&A. Who's presenting? katie + eng bench lead? :calendar:

tara: I can present the runtime optimizations and the benchmark methodology. Will need the micro-bench results and code snippet.

sam: For inbound routing, let's use the HubSpot form on the refapp landing page. Trigger: tag 'refapp-workshop' + route to SDR queue A. Add delayed nurture: 3-email sequence.

zoe: Can we add a small "try now" sandbox link that spins up a preconfigured refapp via GitHub Codespaces? That OOTB flow increases conversion.

mike: Love Codespaces idea. Ops: @deploy-bot can we produce a demo image that boots in <90s? Need a stable endpoint for the demo.

deploy-bot: build started for refapp:sha-4b2c — estimated 12m

alexa: Copy note: avoid technical jargon in the lead gen form. Use 'Try the interactive demo' not 'instantiate environment'.

katie: Messaging iteration: we should A/B test two headlines — one performance-first, one developer-experience-first. Run for first 72h and pick winner.

sam: Analytics: track utm_campaign=refapp-launch, utm_content=headlineA|B. Add event 'refapp_signup' to our console dashboard.

tara: Benchmark snippet for the blog: 
```
Baseline: 1x p3.2xlarge | 200ms/token
Refapp quantized profile: 1x small-gpu | 100ms/token (50% latency, ~40% cost)
```

mike: Can we get a short HOWTO for tutorial (5 steps) to include at bottom of post? I'll draft.

katie: Action items: alexa — finalize doc + screenshots by EOD; mike — draft webinar flow + presenter notes; sam — set up HubSpot form + routing; tara — finalize bench numbers and code sample; zoe — investigate Codespaces template. Ping me when done :eyes:

alexa: on it. pushing doc update now https://docs.google.com/document/d/REFAPP-DRAFT#heading=h.refapp

sam: I'll open the HubSpot ticket and share link here when ready.

katie: cool, thanks team. we'll review tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:
